lineage: MAC (modified Nakamichi CM-700 mics > Sony TC-D5M) > Nak Dragon playback > Cardas audiophile cables > HHB CDR 800 master CD > Samsung SW-232B extraction (EAC v0.9 beta 4) > tracking (CD Wave) > sector boundary verification (shntool

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience tape of the April ’82 Baltimore show, featuring a smoking Jack Straw, soaring Stella Blue, a killer Raven Space and standout Cumberland Blues.
ai_review.review: The recording captures an energetic, high‑octane performance that many fans describe as “smoking” from start to finish.  Highlights include a tight Jack Straw opener, a beautifully voiced Stella Blue, a thunderous Raven Space and a soaring Cumberland Blues, all delivered with crisp interplay between Jerry and Brent and Phil’s booming bass.  Technically the audience source is warm, clean and surprisingly detailed—often likened to a soundboard mix.

ai_rating.rationale: Average user rating ~4.7/5 across 21 reviews; overwhelmingly positive comments on both performance and audio fidelity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, life‑filled ambience with clean, crisp highs; balanced mix where Phil’s bass is booming, Jerry and Brent’s interplay shines; many reviewers say it rivals a soundboard (SBD) in clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set that builds into a powerful Raven Space, followed by an energetic second set with tight transitions and high‑impact closers.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his sweet, crisp vocals (especially on Stella Blue) and tight guitar tone; noted for commanding tempo on Franklin’s Tower and melodic leads.
band_member_comments.Phil: Booming bass highlighted throughout; many reviewers call the Raven Space a "Phil bomb" and commend his solid foundation.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocal harmonies and occasional call‑outs (e.g., On The Road) are mentioned positively.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboard work noted as crisp and in tight interplay with Jerry; his solo receives specific praise.
